R260.note: Canonicalizes with GetFullPath and rejects escapes via GetRelativePath before reading; legitimate relative paths under the root still succeed.

R261.note: Scopes the list query to the authenticated user via findByOwnerUsername, matching the stated contract exactly.

R262.note: Encodes control/line-separator characters and switches to a message-template log call; normal usernames pass through unchanged.

R263.note: Adds the missing per-event admin role check inside the handler; non-admins are silently denied, admins unaffected.

R264.note: Rejects CRLF in email/subject before building the hand-rolled SMTP commands, closing the injection without altering normal sends.

R265.note: Parameterizes the query with AddWithValue; apostrophe-bearing actor values are treated as literal data per the stated contract.

R266.note: Replaces attacker-controlled originalname with a UUID name derived from the sniffed MIME type; JSON url shape and 400 path preserved per contract.

R267.note: Empirically confirmed (execFile('cmd.exe',['/c',...]) reproduced in a scratch Node script) that a reportName containing an embedded quote plus '&' still executes injected commands, because cmd.exe re-parses the whole line itself; the argument array does not close this sink.

R268.note: Adds the missing app.UseAntiforgery() middleware after AddAntiforgery() was already registered, matching the minimal-API POST default and the stated contract.

R269.note: Adds a magic-byte check confirming PNG/JPEG signatures against the declared content type before copying; legitimate images still pass.

R270.note: Swaps StandardEvaluationContext for SimpleEvaluationContext.forReadOnlyDataBinding(), the standard SpEL sandboxing pattern that blocks method/type/constructor/bean access while leaving arithmetic and property reads intact per the contract.

R271.note: Tika content-sniffing plus UUID filenames correctly close the upload vector, but re-encoding through ImageIO.read/write can reject legitimate images ImageIO cannot decode (e.g. CMYK JPEGs) without the write-up disclosing that narrower format support.

R272.note: Removes the stray [IgnoreAntiforgeryToken], reverting the action to the already-registered app-wide AutoValidateAntiforgeryTokenAttribute filter with no other change.

R273.note: Verified via an analogous lxml test (same underlying libxml2 XML_PARSE_NOENT/NONET flags: noent=false alone left the entity unsubstituted and blocked file disclosure even with network entities allowed) that noent:false is the operative fix and closes the exfiltration vector; nonet:true is added defense-in-depth.
